hook: Lowered onto a cruise ship, 110 miles out off Alaska.
narration: This rescue swimmer was lowered toward a cruise ship, a hundred and ten miles out off Alaska.
A crewman aboard the Ryndam was weak and losing consciousness.
The ship called the Coast Guard by satellite phone just before seven in the evening.
A Dolphin crew from Air Station Kodiak came to a hover over the ship's bow.
A litter keeps a patient flat and strapped in, for someone who cannot sit up in a basket.
Then the litter rose toward the door, while the ship kept moving below.
outcome: And the Dolphin crew safely medevaced the crewman off the Ryndam.
title: Cruise ship hoist 110 miles off Alaska
description:
In June 2010, a Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak HH-65 Dolphin crew medevaced a 38-year-old crewmember from the cruise ship Ryndam, 110 miles southeast of Cordova, Alaska.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/315562/ryndam-medevac
